It delivers Employee Assistance Programmes, chronic disease management (mental health, obesity, diabetes, hypertension, and cholesterol), health coaching and consultations, performance workshops, and Mental Health First Aid training for employers, insurers, and individuals. The company reports serving over one million members and 200-plus companies, and states it is certified for HIPAA, GDPR, and ISO/IEC 27001. No public developer portal, API documentation, or API surface is published as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: SAIB & Co.
providers.description: SAIB (Save & Co.) is a Seoul-based Korean intimate cosmetics and wellness brand focused on female empowerment, offering premium condoms and solid feminine cleansing products made with proprietary, health-conscious ingredients such as CranProB. The brand donates 10% of sales revenue to campaigns supporting gender equality and women's rights. SAIB sells direct-to-consumer through a Cafe24-hosted storefront (saibnco.com); its only programmatic surface is the Cafe24 Unified Commerce Platform (UCP) storefront, which exposes an OpenID Connect discovery document and an OAuth 2.0 / OIDC storefront API for this mall. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and enriched into the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Bold
providers.description: Bold (Age Bold, Inc.) is an AI-enabled healthy-aging company founded in 2019 by Amanda Rees and Hari Arul that combines age-friendly virtual care with senior-focused exercise and nutrition programs for Medicare members. The platform delivers personalized at-home programs — live and on-demand classes, balance and fall-prevention regimens, pain and mobility programs, nutrition coaching, and telehealth visits with clinicians — to adults 65 and older, distributed through Medicare Advantage plans, provider groups, and the CMS ACCESS program rather than sold as a developer platform. Bold reports its balance programs lower fall risk and its pain programs reduce joint pain among participating members, and states its platform is HIPAA compliant and requires no lengthy IT integration for plan partners. The company has raised roughly $27M, with a $17M Series A led by Rethink Impact alongside Andreessen Horowitz Bio + Health, Khosla Ventures, Samsung Next, GingerBread Capital, and Primetime Partners. As of this enrichment pass Bold publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, OpenAPI definition, SDKs, or partner API surface — integrations are handled through its partnerships team.

providers.name: Game Theory
providers.description: Game Theory is a Bengaluru-based recreational sports and fitness membership platform operating 25+ centers across the city. Its consumer mobile app offers unlimited multi-sport coaching for kids and All Access adult memberships spanning 8+ sports — swimming, badminton, basketball, football, pickleball, squash, and table tennis — alongside pay-per-use slot booking, live game feeds, and corporate wellness programs. A Techstars-backed company, Game Theory publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record awaiting any future developer platform.

providers.name: Meditopia
providers.description: Meditopia is a holistic mental-wellbeing platform founded in 2017 that blends psychology, technology, and wellness to support the mental, emotional, and physical health of individuals and organizations. For consumers it ships a meditation and mindfulness mobile app (sleep programs, guided meditations, personalized assessments, self-guided content) available in nine-plus languages and used by 40+ million people across 60 countries. For organizations it offers Meditopia for Work: a modern Employee Assistance Program (EAP), 1-on-1 expert sessions, a WellnessPass benefits platform, online trainings, and Soul, an AI wellbeing coach. Meditopia is backed by Creandum. The company operates a consumer mobile app and a B2B web platform; it does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI, developer portal, or /.well-known discovery surface. This profile was surfaced as a Creandum portfolio company and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: Terapify
providers.description: Terapify is an online therapy platform for the Spanish-speaking market, connecting individuals in Mexico and Latin America with certified psychologists for private, secure video-call sessions. Founded in 2019 and backed by 500 Global and Y Combinator, the platform matches patients to therapists via a therapeutic-affinity test, offers individual and couples therapy, parent orientation, and workplace mental-health programs for companies, plus mindfulness, yoga, and breathing resources. It operates as a consumer web and mobile (iOS/Android) product and publishes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: FitOn
providers.description: FitOn is a consumer digital fitness and wellness platform offering free, on-demand workout classes (cardio, strength, yoga, Pilates, HIIT), guided meditation, personalized meal plans and nutrition tracking, recipes, and social challenges. FitOn serves 15 million+ members with celebrity and world-class trainers across mobile, web, and connected-TV apps (Apple TV, Roku, Chromecast, Fire TV). Its FitOn Health arm delivers an enterprise wellness benefit to employers, health plans, and brokers. FitOn is backed by Accel. As of this enrichment pass FitOn publishes no public developer API, developer portal, SDKs, or OpenAPI; consumer and B2B integration is handled through partnership programs rather than a self-serve API.

providers.name: Womaness
providers.description: Womaness is a women-founded midlife wellness brand created to modernize aging for women and to help them navigate the phases their bodies move through around menopause. The direct-to-consumer company sells clean, estrogen-free, doctor-approved and clinically tested skincare, supplements, sexual-health and menopause-support products (including Let's Neck serum, Melt for You inserts and Daily V Soothe) through a Shopify-hosted online store and select retail partners. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Obvious Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network; it is a consumer e-commerce brand with no first-party public developer API surface.

providers.name: Hole19
providers.description: Hole19 (Stat Track Technologies Lda) is a golf app for iOS, Android, and smartwatches used by 4.8M+ golfers across 42,000+ golf courses in 200+ countries. It provides GPS rangefinder distances, digital scorecards, shot tracking, performance statistics, an Otto AI game assistant, and a WHS handicap calculator, plus social features such as LivePlay live leaderboards and a social feed. The company also ships CORE Golf, a practice app with structured plans and 100+ drills, and operates a worldwide golf course directory, a golf glossary, and The 19th Hole magazine. The core app is free with two subscription tiers, Premium and Intelligence. Hole19 does not publish a public developer API; this profile captures its public web, legal, support, and llms.txt surface.

providers.name: Yogaia
providers.description: Yogaia is a Finnish online fitness company, founded in 2013 and headquartered in Espoo, that streams live and on-demand yoga, Pilates, meditation, and workout classes to members on any device. Backed by Point Nine, Inventure, and Sanoma, the service runs as a consumer subscription product (web and mobile apps) with sessions ranging from three-minute quick practices to sixty-minute relaxation programs. As of this enrichment pass Yogaia publishes no public developer program, API reference, or SDKs; its api.yogaia.com host serves the session-based web application backend rather than a documented public API. This profile was surfaced as a Point Nine portfolio lead and is enriched here with verified identity, public web properties, and a live domain-security probe.

providers.name: 10% Happier
providers.description: 10% Happier (now branded Happier Meditation) is a consumer meditation and mindfulness app founded on the best-selling book "10% Happier" by ABC News anchor Dan Harris. The service delivers personalized, science-backed guided meditations, courses, and sleep content from well-known teachers through native iOS and Android apps and a web player, aimed at helping skeptics and busy people build a sustainable mindfulness practice for stress, sleep, focus, and relationships. It operates on a subscription model. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Trinity Ventures and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; 10% Happier is a direct-to-consumer app and does not publish a public developer API, so this record captures its identity, web properties, and domain-security posture.

providers.name: 82 Labs
providers.description: 82 Labs, Inc. (doing business as More Labs) is a Los Angeles-based, science-backed wellness beverage company founded in 2016 by former Tesla engineer Sisun Lee. More Labs makes functional drink supplements sold direct-to-consumer, including Morning Recovery (hydration and post-alcohol recovery with electrolytes and DHM), Liquid Focus (a nootropic caffeine energy shot), and Dream Well (a melatonin and lemon-balm sleep aid). It is a consumer packaged goods (CPG) and e-commerce business with no public developer API, developer portal, SDKs, or machine-readable API artifacts; it was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company. Enrichment on 2026-07-17 confirmed no API surface exists to harvest.

providers.name: Agebold
providers.description: Agebold, which operates as Bold, is a digital healthy-aging platform for adults 65 and older, delivered as a covered benefit through Medicare Advantage plans and other Medicare organizations. Bold offers personalized, science-backed exercise programs shown to reduce fall risk, ease musculoskeletal pain, and increase physical activity, alongside nutrition and weight-loss support (including GLP-1 care), live classes, expert talks, and virtual access to doctors, therapists, and nurse practitioners in select states. The company partners with health plans to improve quality measures, Star Ratings, HOS performance, and total cost of care. Agebold is a Khosla Ventures portfolio company; as of this profile it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or OpenAPI surface.

providers.name: Ferra
providers.description: Ferra is a smart home strength-training system for adults aged 50 and over, built by Aroleap Fitness Private Limited in Bengaluru, India. It pairs a compact wall-mounted adaptive-resistance machine with a mobile app that queues a short guided daily workout of seven functional movements, adapts the weight in real time, tracks progress, and lets users share achievements with family. The service is sold as a no-lock-in monthly subscription (Individual, Duo, and Family tiers) billed through UPI auto-debit. Ferra is a consumer product with no public developer platform or API; this profile captures its identity and public web properties for the API Evangelist network. Backed by Prosus Ventures.

providers.name: Imperfect
providers.description: Imperfect (Imperfect Wellness, Inc.) is a San Francisco-based, Y Combinator-backed (Spring 2026) consumer startup building an adaptive AI training coach for endurance athletes across cycling, trail running, swimming, and other sports. The mobile app connects to a user's wearables and health apps to generate real-time training, recovery, and nutrition recommendations that adapt to how the athlete's body is actually responding day to day, rather than following a static plan written weeks in advance. Founded by Matin Tamizi (previously built and sold two fintech companies and authored a widely used open-source Garmin library used by Stanford Health). Imperfect ships as a consumer mobile application (Google Play) and publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal at this time.

providers.name: Meru Health
providers.description: Meru Health is a digital mental health company delivering a therapist-guided 12-week program for anxiety, depression, stress, and burnout. The platform blends licensed-therapist video sessions, an on-demand app of mindfulness and behavioral practices, an HRV biofeedback wearable, and anonymous peer support. Sold B2B2C to health plans and employers as a covered benefit, it is measurement-based and outcomes-focused. No public developer API, portal, SDK, or documentation surface was found during enrichment; this profile captures the company identity plus a probed domain-security posture.

providers.name: SafelyYou
providers.description: SafelyYou is an ambient-AI platform for senior living communities that reduces falls, reveals resident risk, and surfaces operational and staffing insights without requiring residents to wear devices. Its computer-vision system detects and reviews fall incidents, and the broader product suite spans Safety AI for fall detection, Staffing AI for labor allocation and care tracking, Wellness AI for resident well-being, the Halo next-generation eCall system, and Guardian hardware sensors. SafelyYou reports serving over 1,000 communities and 50,000 residents, with outcomes including roughly 45% fall reduction and longer length of stay. The company integrates with senior-living EHR and eCall systems (Yardi, ALIS, PointClickCare and others) and offers SSO, but publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of DCVC and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: ZOE
providers.description: ZOE (joinzoe.com, canonically zoe.com) is a personalized nutrition and health science company founded on data from one of the largest nutrition research studies in the world. Its membership program pairs at-home testing (gut health, blood sugar, and blood fat responses) with an AI-powered app that scores meals, tracks personal food responses, and delivers science-backed dietary guidance. ZOE also sells consumer products including the Daily30+ whole-food supplement and Gut Health products, and publishes the ZOE Science & Nutrition podcast. The company operates as a direct-to-consumer health brand rather than an API provider, and is tracked here as a Balderton Capital portfolio company; it currently exposes no public developer platform, API, or developer portal.

providers.name: Caresense Pte. Ltd.
providers.description: CareSense Pte. Ltd. (CareSense.ai) is a Singapore-based preventive digital health company building AI-powered health coaching. Its flagship product is Mandy, a 24/7 AI health coach delivered over chat and voice, paired with the CareSense.ai app — a personal health dashboard covering nutrition, exercise, sleep and stress — and integrated health services including blood testing and telemedicine. The company sells both to individuals and to enterprise teams as a workplace wellbeing programme. CareSense was incorporated in Singapore on 14 June 2024 (UEN 202424008M), registered at 160 Robinson Road #14-04, and was founded by Lucas Ngoo, co-founder of Carousell, and Julian Koo, founder of the home-care platform Jaga-Me. As of this enrichment pass CareSense publishes no public API, developer portal, API documentation or SDKs; its technology surface is consumer and enterprise applications fronted by a Vanta-hosted trust center.

providers.name: TOCA Football
providers.description: TOCA Football, Inc. is a technology-enabled soccer experience and entertainment company headquartered in Costa Mesa, California, founded on the training methodology of former US international and Premier League player Eddie Lewis. It operates two businesses: TOCA Soccer, a network of indoor soccer training centers across the United States, Canada and Mexico offering private training, classes, clinics, camps, youth and adult leagues, tournaments and pickup play; and TOCA Social, a soccer-themed dining and entertainment venue brand. Its training centers pair a proprietary ball-delivery machine and digitalized smart targets with the MyTOCA player app, which tracks session performance, player cards, leaderboards and progress. TOCA is the official soccer training partner of Major League Soccer. TOCA publishes no public API, SDK, webhook or developer program: its software ships only as end-user consumer apps and in-venue systems.

providers.name: YAZIO
providers.description: YAZIO GmbH is an Erfurt, Germany based digital health company whose nutrition app pairs calorie and macro tracking with barcode scanning, AI photo food logging, an intermittent-fasting timer, a 3,000-recipe library and body-metric tracking across iOS, Android and the web. The company describes itself as remote-first, cites more than 100 million downloads across over 150 countries, and sells a freemium product: a free tier plus a "YAZIO PRO" subscription transacted through the Apple App Store and Google Play rather than through a pricing page on yazio.com. YAZIO publishes no developer program of any kind — no developer portal, no API reference, no OpenAPI, AsyncAPI or GraphQL contract, no SDKs, no CLI, no MCP server, no changelog, no status page and no security.txt. Its apps talk to a private backend at https://yzapi.yazio.com, which is live but answers 401 with an empty body to anonymous requests and issues OAuth client credentials through no public process. Every YAZIO OpenAPI description, client library and MCP server in circulation is third-party reverse-engineering that states in its own README that it is unofficial and unaffiliated.

providers.name: Bristle
providers.description: Bristle (Bristle Health) is a consumer health company that makes the world's first at-home oral microbiome saliva test, helping people measure, understand, and improve their oral health. Customers order a mail-in saliva collection kit, and Bristle sequences the oral microbiome to report on bacteria associated with cavities, gum disease, and bad breath, then pairs the results with guidance and a line of targeted oral-care products including probiotics. Bristle also works with dental professionals who offer microbiome testing to their patients. The company sells direct to consumers through a Shopify-hosted storefront at bristlehealth.com and is backed by Initialized Capital. There is no first-party public developer API; this profile captures Bristle's public web, commercial, and security surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Lenus eHealth
providers.description: Lenus eHealth is a Copenhagen-headquartered health and fitness technology company that builds a coaching platform for online health and fitness coaches, positioning itself as a growth partner rather than a consumer fitness app. Coaching partners run their businesses through the Lenus web dashboard and branded consumer mobile apps: client onboarding and screening, training and nutrition programming, habit and progress tracking, in-app messaging, content delivery, subscription billing and business analytics. The company also operates Lenus Academy, a certified education program for online coaches, and in the United States offers a GLP-1 weight management program delivered with independent medical partner Beluga Health. Lenus operates from 20+ offices including Copenhagen, Berlin, London, Amsterdam, Stockholm, Madrid, New York and Toronto, and is backed by EQT Ventures. The platform is closed and invitation-based: as of July 2026 Lenus publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs or machine-readable API specifications, and access is available only to coaching partners under a partnership agreement.

providers.name: Perch
providers.description: Perch is a computer-vision weight-room performance monitoring system that captures athlete movement — velocity-based training, jump testing, and strength programming — from 3D cameras mounted on the rack, without wearables or tethers. Spun out of MIT and backed by SoftBank Vision Fund and Techstars, Perch was acquired by sports-technology company Catapult; the perch.fit domain now 301-redirects to catapult.com/perch, where the product is sold and supported as part of Catapult's athlete-monitoring suite. Perch exposes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable API specification — this profile is retained as an identity record for the acquired brand.

providers.name: Bioniq
providers.description: Bioniq is a personalized nutrition and supplement company founded in London in 2019 that combines individual biomarker and blood-test data with a proprietary algorithm to formulate customized vitamin and mineral blends delivered as Swiss-made granules. Its consumer product line spans Bioniq GO (wellness-assessment based), Bioniq PRO (blood-test driven), and Bioniq Essential, supported by iOS and Android apps for tracking health and supplement routines. Bioniq is a portfolio company of HV Capital and now operates within Herbalife. It exposes consumer web, mobile, and partner/affiliate surfaces but publishes no public developer API, SDK, or API documentation as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Cerebral
providers.description: Cerebral is an American telehealth company providing online mental health and wellness care, including therapy, counseling, psychiatric evaluations, and medication management delivered through its website and mobile app on a subscription basis. Founded in 2020 by Kyle Robertson and Ho Anh, the company treats conditions such as depression, anxiety, insomnia, ADHD, and substance use disorder. Cerebral is backed by SoftBank Vision Fund 2, which led a $300M Series C in December 2021 valuing the company at roughly $4.8B. Cerebral is a direct-to-consumer product and does not publish a public developer API or programmatic surface; this API Evangelist profile tracks its public company and website properties.

providers.name: Fightcamp
providers.description: FightCamp is a consumer connected-fitness company that sells an at-home boxing and kickboxing training system combining physical equipment (a free-standing bag, quick-wrap gloves, and Bluetooth motion-tracking punch trackers) with a subscription app of on-demand classes led by professional fighters. The trackers use motion sensors and AI to measure punch output, speed, and workout stats, syncing to a member app and customer dashboard for progress tracking. FightCamp is a direct-to-consumer hardware-plus-membership business (backed by IVP) and does not publish a public developer API; this profile captures its public web, commerce, support, and domain-security surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Fiture
providers.description: Fiture is a consumer smart-home fitness company that makes interactive AI-powered fitness mirrors for at-home workouts. Its hardware line includes the Fiture Core flagship mirror and the compact Fiture Mini, each pairing a wall-mounted display with a camera and on-device AI that delivers real-time motion tracking, gesture recognition, rep counting, and posture feedback across a library of live and on-demand fitness classes sold through a membership. The company was founded in China and is backed by venture investor Hongshan (formerly Sequoia Capital China). Fiture operates a direct-to-consumer commerce and membership website but does not currently publish a public developer program, API, or SDK; this API Evangelist profile tracks the company and its public web surface (support, legal, and account pages).

providers.name: Mindbloom
providers.description: Mindbloom is a direct-to-consumer telehealth company offering at-home ketamine-assisted therapy for anxiety, depression, and PTSD, combining psychiatric clinician oversight, guided therapeutic sessions, and peer support. Clients complete a psychiatric evaluation, receive either sublingual tablets or subcutaneous injectable treatments, and are supported through a structured program with monitoring and integration guidance. The company reports having facilitated over 200,000 ketamine therapy sessions. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 8vc and added to the API Evangelist network; enrichment found no public API, developer platform, or developer documentation — Mindbloom is a consumer healthcare service, not an API provider.

providers.name: Signos
providers.description: Signos is a metabolic health technology company founded by Sharam Fouladgar-Mercer and Bill Tancer that pairs a continuous glucose monitor (CGM) sensor with an AI-powered mobile app to help people understand their individual metabolic responses to food and make data-driven lifestyle changes for weight management. In August 2025 Signos received FDA clearance as the first over-the-counter glucose monitoring system for weight loss, making it available without a prescription to adults not on insulin. The platform integrates with the Dexcom Stelo sensor, Apple Health, Google Health Connect, smartwatches and smart scales, delivers real-time glucose insights, personalized meal and movement recommendations, registered-dietitian support, and daily and weekly metabolism scores, with optional GLP-1 medication access through partner healthcare providers. Signos was surfaced as a portfolio company of GV (Google Ventures). It is a consumer-facing product and does not currently publish a developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: SuppCo
providers.description: SuppCo is a consumer supplement tracking and optimization platform, describing itself as the world's first real supplement tracker and optimizer. Its iOS and Android app lets people log their supplement stack and get a personalized StackScore across quality, dosing, goal coverage, and nutrient levels, plus a TrustScore that rates products on 29 attributes. It is backed by a database of 160,000+ products, 20,000+ research studies, and 80+ expert protocols from functional-medicine practitioners. SuppCo is in open beta (free, with an optional Pro tier) and was acquired by Function Health. No public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal is currently published; this profile captures its public web, security, and legal surface. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Union Square Ventures.

providers.name: Nova Benefits
providers.description: Nova Benefits is an India-based employee health and benefits platform that provides group health insurance, super top-up plans, and COVID-19 cover alongside wellness services such as telehealth consultations, mental-wellness support, fitness programs, maternity benefits, and annual health, dental and vision checkups. It gives HR teams an employer dashboard for administering benefits and managing claims, and gives employees web and mobile (iOS/Android) apps to view coverage, book consultations, and file and track claims. The company reports serving 500+ companies covering 200,000+ employees, is ISO 27001:2022 certified and SOC 2 Type II compliant, and operates as an IRDAI-regulated insurance broker. Nova Benefits publishes no public API or developer platform.

providers.name: Rex Inc
providers.description: Rex Inc, operating as Rex.fit (BabylonAI Inc.), is a Y Combinator (W23) health and fitness company building AI-powered, fully automated nutrition tracking. Its consumer products include Rex Nutribot, a WhatsApp AI nutrition coach; the Drop, a wearable AI camera pendant that detects meals and automatically logs calories, protein, carbs, and fats via computer vision; an AI body scanner; and personalized coaching with daily health reports. Rex also offers a white-label B2B nutrition-and-fitness AI that fitness chains and app builders integrate to add meal logging (photo, barcode, or text), recipe and meal-plan generation, workout logging, 3D body scans, and nutrition analytics under their own brand.

providers.name: Greator
providers.description: Greator (formerly GEDANKENtanken, founded 2012) is Germany's largest personal- development platform, headquartered in Cologne and serving roughly 234,000 customers. It runs a B2C ecosystem of free content (masterclasses, podcasts, a YouTube channel, magazine articles and personality tests) alongside paid, certified training programs such as The School of Life, Momentum Mastery, the Finance Academy and TheKey speaking training. Greator also produces live events including the annual Greator Festival (15,000+ attendees, 400+ speakers) and operates Greator Business, a B2B corporate offering. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of HV Capital and added to the API Evangelist network. Greator publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or /.well-known discovery surface; this profile captures its identity, web properties, and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Purely B
providers.description: PurelyB is a natural superfood and wellness brand founded by Raja Jesrina Arshad, rooted in ancestral Asian health traditions and selling halal-certified, vegan, gluten-free herbal supplements (Pegaga, Tiger Milk Mushroom, Manjakani, Super Immune-C and a SuperKids line) direct to consumers across Malaysia and Singapore. The storefront runs on Shopify and exposes a standards-based agent-commerce surface: a Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) merchant profile with a hosted MCP shopping server, Shopify Customer Account OAuth/OIDC, and a published llms.txt for AI shopping agents. Surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and enriched from its public developer/agent surface.

providers.name: Zeel
providers.description: Zeel is an on-demand wellness marketplace that connects consumers with licensed, background-checked massage therapists for in-home, in-hotel, in-office, and event chair massage delivered same-day and often within an hour of booking. The platform covers a range of modalities including Swedish, deep tissue, sports, prenatal, sleep, and couples massage, and offers memberships, gift certificates, and a spa-staffing service (Zeel Spa Staffing) that supplies therapists to hotels and spas. Zeel operates a consumer-facing web and mobile booking experience across dozens of US metros; it does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or partner integration program.

providers.name: GlossGenius
providers.description: GlossGenius is a business management platform for the beauty, wellness, and health services industry, combining appointment scheduling, integrated payment processing (flat 2.6% rate), point of sale, marketing, client management, staff and payroll tools, and AI agents that answer booking inquiries and follow up with clients. It serves solo professionals and multi-location businesses such as salons, spas, barbershops, and medspas, powering more than 120,000 appointment-based businesses. GlossGenius was surfaced as a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners and Techstars and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass GlossGenius publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, SDKs, MCP server, or developer portal; this profile captures the company identity and public link surface only.

providers.name: Cyberpsyc
providers.description: CyberPsyc Software Solutions, operating as WellTrack Boost (now part of ProtoCall Services), builds self-guided, clinically-supported digital cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT) tools for behavioral health and wellness. The platform lets users assess and understand their mental health on their own devices and schedule through MoodCheck mood tracking, the Zen Room, a Thought Diary, an Activity Scheduler, Fun and Achievement planning, and guided modules for stress, anxiety, and depression. WellTrack Boost is deployed by college counseling centers and certified community behavioral health clinics, offering institutional single sign-on through a SAML integration surface. No public developer REST API or OpenAPI is currently published.

providers.name: Hykso
providers.description: Hykso, Inc. is the company behind FightCamp, an at-home boxing and kickboxing training system that pairs a free-standing bag, quick-wrap gloves, and wireless motion-tracking punch trackers with an on-demand library of trainer-led workouts. The Hykso punch trackers began as standalone wearable sensors that measure punch count, speed, and output for boxers and gyms, and now power FightCamp's real-time performance stats and workout scoring. This profile is a company stub in the API Evangelist network; Hykso/FightCamp is a direct-to-consumer connected-fitness brand and does not publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Myclubs
providers.description: Myclubs is a Vienna- and Zurich-based digital sports membership company, founded in 2014 by Tobias Homberger, that gives members flexible access to a network of more than 1,200 sports and fitness providers across Austria and Switzerland through a single subscription. One membership covers over 35 sport and activity types and more than 10,000 bookable workouts per week, from gyms and yoga studios to tennis, boxing and cross training. Myclubs also runs a corporate fitness program used by over 300 employers as an employee benefit. The company was acquired by Urban Sports Club in August 2024 and is a portfolio company of Speedinvest. Myclubs is a consumer-facing membership brand and does not publish a public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API specification.

providers.name: Somethings
providers.description: Somethings is a teen mental health support platform that connects adolescents with Certified Peer Specialist Mentors through a mobile app for iOS and Android. Rather than traditional therapy or AI chatbots, teens can call or chat anytime with trained mentors who have personal lived experience overcoming challenges like anxiety, depression, self-harm, eating disorders, and ADHD, backed by clinical supervision. The service is HIPAA-compliant and sold to health plans, insurers, employers, and directly to parents. Somethings is a venture-backed company in the API Evangelist network; it operates a consumer/clinical mobile product and does not currently publish a public developer API surface.

providers.name: Chi Longevity
providers.description: Chi Longevity is a Singapore-based longevity medicine and healthy-aging clinic that focuses on biological-age optimization rather than reactive medicine, built on The Maier Method developed by co-founder Professor Andrea Maier. The practice combines precision health mapping (blood panels, genetic and cognitive testing, cardiovascular and metabolic analysis), flagship and specialised longevity programmes, cognitive and physical training, a branded NMN supplement, and ongoing support through health coaching, physician and dietitian consultations, and a client portal. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network; no public developer API is currently published, so this profile carries the company identity, domain-security posture, and published web properties rather than API artifacts.

providers.name: Hallow
providers.description: Hallow is the #1 Catholic and Christian prayer, meditation, and Bible app, offering guided daily prayer, the Rosary, Lectio Divina, the Examen, Christian meditation, faith-based sleep stories, Scripture readings, and audio-guided sessions led by well-known voices. Founded in 2018 and based in Chicago, Hallow is a consumer mobile application (iOS and Android) with a subscription tier (Hallow Plus), and it runs programs for parishes, families, and gifting. Hallow does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal, so this profile captures its public web and product surface. Backed by General Catalyst, Homebrew, and Uncork Capital.

providers.name: Aaptiv
providers.description: Aaptiv is a digital fitness and wellness platform offering 10,000+ on-demand audio and video workout classes, AI-powered coaching, access to a network of gyms and studios, and wellness resources such as meditation and mindfulness. It is sold to employers as an employee benefit, to health plans, and to individuals seeking personalized fitness. Backed by Insight Partners. Aaptiv publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal at this time; this API Evangelist profile captures its public web, support, and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Baby2Body
providers.description: Baby2Body is the flagship consumer wellness app from Body Collective, a female-focused health and wellness company founded by sports psychologist Melinda Nicci. The app delivers personalized fitness, nutrition, and mental-health support across the fertility, pregnancy, postpartum, parenting, and broader women's-health stages, paired with an AI health coach named Bella, on-demand programs (prenatal fitness, meal plans, labor prep), expert-backed articles, and a stage-specific newsletter. Baby2Body reports over two million users and is backed by 500 Global. This profile has been enriched from the company's public consumer surfaces; no public developer portal, API, or machine-readable specification was found.

providers.name: Inkblot Therapy
providers.description: Inkblot Therapy is a Canadian digital mental health platform, part of GreenShield, that delivers secure virtual therapy and counselling online. It matches individuals to licensed counsellors, social workers, psychotherapists, and psychologists using a clinically designed questionnaire, and delivers confidential video sessions. Inkblot serves individuals directly, employers and organizations through Employee Assistance Programs (EAP) and mental health benefits, and practitioners who provide care on the platform. The company operates consumer and business web applications (app.inkblottherapy.com, business.inkblottherapy.com) but does not publish a public developer program, API documentation, SDKs, or an OpenAPI description. This profile was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network as a lead; enrichment reflects the public web and DNS/security surface only.

providers.name: Rescripted
providers.description: Rescripted is a digital women's health platform dedicated to empowering women across the entire lifecycle, from first period to last. It combines an editorial content hub of expert-reviewed articles, videos, and clinical research with Clara, an AI-powered health companion built on thousands of real questions and reviewed by medical experts. The platform spans menstrual health, fertility, pregnancy, sexual health, general wellness, and condition management for PCOS, endometriosis, and related concerns, and works with 200+ health and wellness partners. Founded by Kristyn Hodgdon and Abby Mercado and backed by Techstars, Rescripted is a consumer-facing product with no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal at this time.

providers.name: Meela
providers.description: Meela is an AI voice companion and voice-based ride service built for older adults, backed by Bain Capital Ventures. Members connect through scheduled phone calls with no app, device, or subscription required — Meela calls on a chosen schedule, remembers names, preferences, and past conversations, and shares select privacy-conscious insights with caregivers. A "Meela for Business" offering brings the same companionship to senior living facilities with care-team dashboards, mood/engagement alerts, and EHR documentation, and the company advertises HIPAA and SOC 2 compliance. Meela publishes only a consumer marketing site and a member sign-in portal; it exposes no public developer API, documentation, or SDK surface at this time.

providers.name: Carreira Beauty
providers.description: Carreira Beauty (carreirabeauty.com) is a Brazilian online job marketplace connecting beauty, aesthetics, and wellness professionals with employment and freelance opportunities. The platform operates as a two-sided network that lets professionals — manicurists, hairdressers, estheticians, makeup artists, barbers, masotherapists, eyebrow designers, and salon receptionists — create a free professional profile and discover nearby openings, while salons, aesthetic clinics, spas, and studios post jobs and freelance ("freelas") shifts. It offers geographic filtering to match professionals with local roles, direct employer-to-professional communication over WhatsApp, and one free job posting per business with no credit card required. It is a portfolio company of 500 Global. Carreira Beauty is a consumer web application and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation.

providers.name: Lifesum
providers.description: Lifesum is a Stockholm-based digital health company whose consumer mobile application helps people improve their well-being through food logging, calorie and macronutrient tracking, personalized meal plans, recipes, and habit building. Backed by Balderton Capital, the company operates a subscription business-to-consumer product across iOS and Android in a dozen languages. As of this profile Lifesum publishes no public developer program, API documentation, or partner API portal, so this entry is an identity-only company record in the API Evangelist network rather than an API profile.

providers.name: Athos
providers.description: Athos is a sports performance technology company founded in 2012 and based in Redwood City, California, that builds athletic apparel with embedded surface electromyography (EMG) sensors. Its garments and snap-on Athos Core module capture muscle activity, effort, and motion data, streaming it over Bluetooth to a mobile app and coaching dashboard so athletes, trainers, and sports scientists can measure muscular exertion, fatigue, and return-to-play readiness in real time. Athos is a consumer and team hardware brand with no publicly documented developer API; this profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Lightspeed Venture Partners and enriched for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Aspect Health
providers.description: Aspect Health is a digital health company offering a science-backed program for women managing PCOS (Polycystic Ovary Syndrome). Its PCOS program combines continuous glucose monitoring (CGM), personalized coaching from board-certified health coaches, at-home lab testing for inflammation, hormonal, cardiovascular, and metabolic markers, and the Aida AI dietitian, all delivered through a mobile app. Additional programs cover weight loss, general women's health, and a 21-day check up, with HSA/FSA-eligible plans. Aspect Health is a Techstars-backed company and operates as a consumer (B2C) health platform; it does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or MCP server.

providers.name: Endel
providers.description: Endel is a wellness technology company that generates personalized, adaptive soundscapes to help people focus, relax, sleep, and stay active. Its patented technology creates endless real-time audio that responds to inputs such as time of day, weather, circadian rhythm, heart rate, and location, delivered across iOS, Android, macOS, Windows, web, Apple Watch, Apple TV, Amazon Fire TV, and Alexa. Endel is a consumer application; as of this profile it does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or OpenAPI surface, so this repo captures its identity and public web properties rather than API artifacts.

providers.name: Lina
providers.description: Lina is a medical coworking company providing space, community, and support for independent healthcare practitioners in private practice. Founded by Vicrum Puri and Rachel Puri, Lina offers turnkey private office suites alongside on-demand medical, therapy, and bodywork spaces that are HIPAA and OSHA compliant and bookable by the hour or by the day. Locations operate in NoMad and Grand Central in New York City and Aventura, Florida, with expansion announced for Washington DC, West Palm Beach, the Upper West Side, and Brooklyn. Lina is a Bloomberg Beta portfolio company. It operates a Webflow marketing site and publishes no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable interface as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Scape
providers.description: Scape (Scape Wellness) is an on-demand wellness technology platform in Latin America that lets customers book professional spa experiences delivered to their home, apartment, hotel, Airbnb, office, or corporate event. Certified, identity-verified therapists arrive with all required equipment — professional massage table, towels, oils, and materials. The catalog spans relaxing, deep tissue, sports, prenatal, lymphatic drainage, reflexology, and couples massages; facials; body treatments; and combined facial-plus-massage experiences, alongside personal and corporate gift cards and workplace wellness programs. Scape operates in Mexico, Colombia, Chile, and the Dominican Republic via iOS and Android apps, with payments through MercadoPago and PayPal. It is a consumer booking platform and does not publish a public developer API or developer portal. Backed by 500 Global.

providers.name: Second Nature
providers.description: Second Nature is a UK-based digital weight-loss programme that combines NHS-trusted, CQC-regulated clinical care with dietitian-led coaching and behaviour-change support. The service pairs weight-loss medication (including Wegovy, Mounjaro, oral semaglutide and Orlistat programmes) with personalised medication reviews, a mobile app for tracking, and a science-based content library of guides and member stories. It operates as a registered pharmacy, supports NHS referrals and partnerships, and was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and Speedinvest. As of this enrichment pass Second Nature publishes a consumer marketing site and an llms.txt discovery file but exposes no public developer portal, API reference, SDKs, or machine-readable API surface.

providers.name: FITCO
providers.description: Fitco is the leading management software for boutique fitness studios and gyms in Latin America. It lets centers administer reservations, memberships, payments, online classes and check-in, and provides a custom website and mobile app for each studio's members. It specializes in pilates, barre, indoor cycling, yoga, functional training, strength, sports academies and wellness centers. Fitco operates in Mexico, Peru, Colombia, Chile, Argentina and the United States; as of May 2026 more than 1,400 fitness centers use it. It integrates online payments via Stripe and Mercado Pago and customer acquisition via Wellhub and TotalPass.

bands.label: Minimal
bands.blurb: Index entry only; little beyond a description and a link.

providers.name: ElCoach
providers.description: ElCoach (الكوتش) is a Cairo, Egypt based fitness and nutrition technology company serving the Middle East and North Africa. Its bilingual Arabic/English mobile app delivers personalized workout routines and healthy meal plans tailored to each user, combining certified trainers and nutritionists with AI-driven personalization. The product is a consumer subscription app distributed on iOS and Android with in-app payments; it does not publish a public developer API program. ElCoach is backed by 500 Global (500 Startups), Endure Capital, Wise Capital, and the Misk 500 MENA and Google accelerators, and was added to the API Evangelist network as a 500 Global portfolio company.

providers.name: Kotcha
providers.description: Kotcha is a consumer running-coaching mobile application operated by PACEUP SAS, a French company based in Paris, and co-founded with marathon world-record holder Eliud Kipchoge and the NN Running Team. The app generates personalized, adaptive training plans for 5K, 10K, half-marathon and marathon distances, delivered through a conversational AI coach that adapts to completed workouts, and it imports activity and health data from Strava, Garmin Connect, Apple, Coros and Huawei wearables. Kotcha raised EUR 3.5M in October 2025 in a round led by Racine2, operated by Serena and makesense. Kotcha is a consumer subscription product distributed through the Apple App Store and Google Play; it publishes no developer portal, no API documentation and no machine-readable API contract, and its terms of service explicitly prohibit automated access to the service. This profile records that absence rather than an API surface.

providers.name: Ergatta
providers.description: Ergatta is a connected-fitness company that makes game-based home rowing machines, pairing WaterRower-derived water-resistance hardware handcrafted in Rhode Island with a gamified software platform of interactive challenges (Endeavor, Meteor, Wavelength), live and on-demand races, scenic rows, coached classes, and custom workouts. Ergatta sells the Luxe and Lite rowers plus upgrade kits for existing WaterRower and Concept2 machines, delivered through a Shopify-hosted direct-to-consumer storefront with a membership subscription. Ergatta does not publish a public developer API; this API Evangelist profile captures its public web surface and identity for network discovery.

providers.name: Pluto Brand
providers.description: Pluto (Plutopillow) is a Los Angeles-based direct-to-consumer sleep wellness brand best known for the Pluto Pillow, a made-to-order pillow custom-built around each customer's unique sleep profile via an online sleep quiz. The company also sells the PUFF body pillow, the POD travel pillow, and temperature-regulating bedding, and offers a 125-night risk-free trial with free shipping and returns. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network, Pluto is a consumer e-commerce brand with no public developer platform, API, SDKs, or partner-integration surface at this time; this profile captures its public web properties for discovery.

providers.name: Aumio
providers.description: Aumio (Aumio GmbH) is a Berlin-based children's digital-health company behind a freemium sleep, meditation, and mindfulness mobile app for kids aged roughly 0-10 and their families. The app offers 200+ audio experiences - bedtime stories, soundscapes, white noise, sleep music, and guided meditations - added to weekly, with parts of the subscription reimbursed by German statutory health-insurance providers as a certified prevention course. Founded in 2020 and backed by Partech, Aumio operates as a consumer B2C product (iOS, Android, and web) and publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; this API Evangelist profile captures its public web and domain footprint.

providers.name: Blue Fever
providers.description: Blue Fever is a social and mental-health app for young people that pairs a judgment-free peer community with "Blue," an AI emotional-support companion, under the tagline "A place to feel seen, not be seen." Users share thoughts, moods, and creative expression and receive support from both community members and the AI companion, alongside curated wellness resources and crisis support. The app is available on iOS and Android, has been featured as an Apple App of the Day, and carries a 4.6 App Store rating. The company was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network; it is a consumer application with no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface at this time.

providers.name: Breathwrk
providers.description: Breathwrk is a consumer health and performance app offering guided breathing exercises to reduce stress, improve sleep, boost energy, and enhance athletic and social performance. It packages more than 50 science-backed breathing techniques with music, haptics, coach-led classes, and progress tracking across calming, sleep, energizing, performance, and social categories. Breathwrk is available on iOS and Android with free and Pro subscription tiers plus a Breathwrk for Business program for organizations, and the company is now part of Peloton. Breathwrk publishes no public API, SDK, or developer program; this profile is maintained by API Evangelist and reflects the company's live web presence and security posture.

providers.name: Future
providers.description: Future (Future Research, Inc., future.co) is a consumer fitness technology company that delivers custom, one-on-one personal training through a mobile app. Members are paired with a dedicated certified coach who builds an individualized workout program, provides real-time messaging and accountability check-ins, and adapts the plan over time. The product includes an exercise library with form-guidance videos, flexible scheduling, and Apple Watch integration for workout tracking. Future is a direct-to-consumer subscription service (first month $50, then $199/month with a 30-day money-back guarantee) and does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, or OpenAPI. It is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a Kleiner Perkins portfolio company.

providers.name: Modern Age
providers.description: Modern Age is a longevity-focused health and wellness clinic based on New York City's Upper East Side. It provides proactive aging interventions including comprehensive Aging Wellness Assessments (blood work, bone-density scans, cognitive testing, and clinician consultation), IV drip therapies, vitamin injections, hormone therapy, medically supervised weight loss, and aesthetic skin and hair treatments. Backed by GV (Google Ventures), the company blends clinical diagnostics with wellness services to help members understand and proactively slow the aging process. Modern Age is a consumer health clinic and does not currently publish a public developer API or documentation surface.

providers.name: Sweatcoin
providers.description: Sweatcoin is a health-and-fitness app that converts a user's physical steps and movement into a digital currency ("sweatcoins") that can be redeemed for gadgets, subscriptions, travel vouchers, charity donations, and cryptocurrency. Its proprietary movement-validation algorithms count outdoor steps while, the company states, not selling location data. Sweatcoin reports being a top-3 health & fitness app worldwide with tens of millions of users across 180+ countries, and partners with brands and organizations (NHS, Apple, Amazon and 600+ others) through sponsored challenges, clubs, boosts and an affiliate marketplace. The team also launched the Sweat Economy ($SWEAT), a NEAR-Protocol "movement economy" token, and the Sweat Wallet app, turning tracked movement into on-chain digital value. Sweatcoin exposes no public REST/OpenAPI developer surface; integration is via partner and marketplace programs and the SWEAT on-chain token.

providers.name: Well
providers.description: Well is a personalized health engagement platform for employers and their workforce, marketed as "your personalized daily health partner." It pairs an AI-driven health engine that delivers tailored interventions and behavior-change nudges with human "Well Guides," across a mobile and web experience, and ties outcomes to a performance-based ROI guarantee for the sponsoring employer. Well powers wellness programs, health challenges, biometric screenings, premium reductions, and rewards for large employer and benefits clients including Bank of America, USAA, Sam's Club, UNC Health, MGM, Regions, Amentum, and Octapharma. The company is backed by General Catalyst and was added to the API Evangelist network as a venture-portfolio lead; enrichment found a public WordPress marketing/campaign presence at well.co but no public developer API, SDKs, documentation, or developer portal.

providers.name: The Mind Company
providers.description: The Mind Company is a consumer mental-fitness company that builds a multi-app platform for cognitive and emotional wellbeing. Its apps include Elevate (cognitive training across memory, vocabulary, math, and more), Balance (personalized meditation for sleep, stress, and focus), and Spark (puzzle-based learning). The company is a portfolio company of Felicis and was added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile. As a direct-to-consumer mobile app business, The Mind Company publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or developer documentation; this profile captures its identity, public web properties, and probed security posture.

providers.name: Nourish
providers.description: Nourish is a virtual nutrition-counseling telehealth platform that connects patients with Registered Dietitian Nutritionists (RDNs) through insurance-covered video appointments in all 50 states. Its network of more than 10,000 dietitians supports conditions including diabetes, eating disorders, heart health, and gut health, and a companion mobile app handles meal and goal tracking, secure messaging, lab-work review, and between-session support. Nourish verifies insurance and submits claims on the patient's behalf, with the company reporting that 94% of patients pay $0 out of pocket. Backed by Index Ventures, Menlo Ventures, and Susa Ventures, the company raised a $100M Series C. Nourish exposes a consumer marketing and patient-app surface only; no public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation are published at this time.

providers.name: TheSkimm
providers.description: TheSkimm is a digital media company founded in 2012 that curates news, lifestyle, money, career, and wellness content for a primarily female audience, delivered through email newsletters (the flagship Daily Skimm, plus Well Played, Skimm Well + Good, and Skimm Shopping), a mobile app, podcasts, and shopping guides. It is now part of Everyday Health, Inc., a Ziff Davis company. TheSkimm operates as a consumer media and audience business rather than an API provider: it publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, SDKs, or machine-readable API specifications. This API Evangelist profile was seeded as a portfolio lead of GV (Google Ventures) and enriched with the company's public identity, link properties, and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Goop
providers.description: Goop is a modern lifestyle and wellness brand founded in 2008 by Gwyneth Paltrow, launched from her kitchen as a weekly email newsletter and grown into a content-and-commerce company spanning editorial journalism, e-commerce, and its own product lines across beauty, skincare, supplements, food, fashion, home, and travel. Goop operates goop.com as a curated online shop and digital magazine, publishes wellness and beauty guidance, and sells goop-branded product lines (including goopglow and goop Beauty) alongside a curated marketplace of third-party brands. It is a privately held company backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners (Series C, 2017) and other investors. Goop does not currently operate a public developer program or API; this profile captures its company identity and public web surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: HumanCo
providers.description: HumanCo is a mission-driven consumer packaged goods and wellness holding company that builds and acquires better-for-you food, beverage, and lifestyle brands made with real, clean ingredients and free of seed oils and highly processed inputs. Its portfolio spans brands and concepts such as Against the Grain (gluten-free foods), True Food Kitchen (health-focused restaurants), and Grove Collaborative (sustainable home and personal care). Surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. HumanCo operates a marketing and e-commerce web presence but publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or technical developer platform at this time.

providers.name: Lucid Lane
providers.description: Lucid Lane (now operating as Skyler Health) is a telehealth mental health platform delivering virtual talk therapy and counseling for mental health conditions, an AI-powered coaching companion, and guided meditation and mindfulness content through its Listen Therapy service. Originally founded to help patients taper off opioids and manage medication dependence during and after surgery, the company has since broadened into remote behavioral and mental health care delivered to members, employers, clinics, and providers. It is a consumer- and employer-facing care service with no public developer or API surface; member access is via the Skyler Health member portal. Backed by Accel and Battery Ventures.

providers.name: Optimal
providers.description: Optimal is a preventive-health and longevity company based in Mexico City, backed by 500 Global, operating across Latin America (Mexico, Colombia, and Peru). Optimal offers a consumer blood test that analyzes more than 300 biomarkers and uses AI to surface problems before symptoms appear, positioning itself as a predictive health platform (branded "health OS") that integrates biological data, wearable metrics, behavioral patterns, and medical history into longitudinal health models to identify risk before it becomes disease. The company sells directly to consumers via a web app and subscriptions and does not currently publish a public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation.

providers.name: Ritual
providers.description: Ritual is a direct-to-consumer health and wellness brand that sells traceable, scientifically-formulated vitamins and nutritional supplements, best known for its Essential for Women multivitamin, prenatal and postnatal formulas, and protein products. The company emphasizes a "clean label" approach with a visible, traceable supply chain and university-backed clinical studies, sold primarily through a subscription model on ritual.com. As of this enrichment pass Ritual operates as a consumer e-commerce business and publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or API surface; this profile captures its identity and domain-security posture within the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Rosebud
providers.description: Rosebud is an AI-powered journaling application for personal growth, combining journaling, habit-building, and emotional support in one experience. Users write or speak entries and receive conversational AI feedback, long-term pattern recognition, guided modes (including Internal Family Systems), automated weekly insight reports, and voice journaling, with end-to-end encryption for privacy. It is available on iOS, Android, and the web. Rosebud is a consumer product with no public API, SDK, or developer platform; it is surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners, Initialized Capital, and Khosla Ventures.

providers.name: Sleep Number
providers.description: Sleep Number Corporation (NASDAQ: SNBR) designs, manufactures, and retails smart adjustable-firmness beds and sleep-wellness products, sold through an omnichannel US retail model. Its Sleep Number 360 smart beds run the proprietary SleepIQ operating system, which captures biometric sleep data each night and returns actionable insights to improve sleep health. Sleep Number does not publish a public developer API or developer portal; the SleepIQ platform is a closed, undocumented backend consumed only by the first-party mobile and web apps. The community has reverse-engineered unofficial SleepIQ client libraries (Python, Go, PHP), but these are not first-party and are not endorsed by Sleep Number. This profile was surfaced as a legacy portfolio lead of Norwest Venture Partners and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: Welly
providers.description: Welly is a health and wellness brand and Certified B Corporation that designs first aid and personal care products, best known for its patterned Flex Fabric adhesive bandages, first aid kits, hydrocolloid blemish and bug-bite patches, and antiseptic wipes. Founded to make caring for everyday cuts, scrapes, and playtime injuries more joyful, Welly sells direct-to-consumer through a Shopify storefront at getwelly.com and via national retail partners. As a consumer packaged-goods company it publishes no public developer API or documentation; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record enriched from its public web presence.

providers.name: MyARC Fitness

The platform pairs with smart trainers and heart-rate monitors over Bluetooth and ANT+, and the Zwift Companion mobile app provides in-game messaging, ride control, and route discovery. providers.name: Open mHealth
providers.description: Open mHealth is a nonprofit, community-driven initiative that develops open standards and open-source software for making patient-generated health data interoperable across mobile apps, wearables, clinical systems, and electronic health records. Its core contribution is a library of clinically validated JSON Schema data point schemas — covering physical activity, sleep, heart rate, blood pressure, body weight, blood glucose, and other vital signs — with the sleep, physical-activity, and metadata schemas now superseded by IEEE 1752.1, the IEEE standard for Mobile Health Data co-shepherded by the Open mHealth community. Around the schemas Open mHealth ships a stack of Apache-2.0 reference implementations: Shimmer (a Java/Spring server that pulls health data from Fitbit, Google Fit, iHealth, Misfit, RunKeeper, and Withings APIs and normalizes it into Open mHealth or IEEE 1752.1 data points), omh-dsu-ri (a Data Storage Unit reference implementation exposing an OAuth 2.0-secured Data Point REST API on top of MongoDB and PostgreSQL), Granola (an Objective-C library that serializes Apple HealthKit samples into Open mHealth JSON), a web visualizations library built on D3 and Plottable.js, the OMH-on-FHIR mapping that aligns Open mHealth data points to HL7 FHIR resources, and a sample-data-generator. Open mHealth operates as the steward of the standard, the schema and unit registry at registry.openmhealth.org, and a developer community of thousands of developers and health organizations including Cornell Tech, Kaiser Permanente, Stanford School of Medicine, UC Davis, and UCSF. The project has no commercial API, no paid tier, and no hosted SaaS — all artifacts are open source under Apache 2.0 and the standard itself is openly published.
