providers.description: Proclaim, built by Fresh Health, Inc., makes a custom-jet oral health system that replaces traditional flossing with a 3D-scanned, custom-fitted mouthpiece that pulses water through up to 60 jets to clean between teeth and below the gumline in about seven seconds. The consumer device is clinically shown to reduce gum bleeding and plaque, and is backed by Khosla Ventures. Proclaim is a direct-to-consumer oral-care hardware and wellness brand; it publishes a marketing and e-commerce site, a dental-professional portal, a help/knowledge center, and a blog, but exposes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or machine-readable specification. This profile was surfaced as a Khosla Ventures portfolio lead and enriched with the identity and web properties the company actually publishes plus a probed domain-security profile; there is no API surface to catalog.

providers.name: Talofa Games
providers.description: Talofa Games is a mobile game developer and publisher backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z). The studio builds social fitness games that turn real-world physical activity into cooperative multiplayer play. Its flagship title, Run Legends, is a free-to-play running RPG available on iOS and Android in which players' real-world runs and walks power team battles against monsters, and its newer title Monster Walk is in closed beta. Talofa Games is a consumer mobile-gaming company and does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this API Evangelist profile captures its company identity and public web presence rather than an API surface.

providers.name: Tripp
providers.description: TRIPP is a digital mental-wellness company whose consumer app delivers immersive, interactive meditation, breathwork and mood-management experiences across virtual-reality headsets (including Meta Quest and PlayStation VR) and mobile devices. It blends guided sessions, generative visuals, spatial audio and gamified "trips" to help people manage stress, focus, mood and sleep. Tripp is backed by Mayfield. As of this enrichment pass Tripp operates a consumer-facing application and an Intercom-powered help center but publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation portal; its web properties sit behind a bot-mitigation (captcha) wall, so no OpenAPI, llms.txt, or /.well-known discovery documents were retrievable.

providers.name: BRND.ME
providers.description: BRND.ME (legally Mensa Brand Technologies Private Limited) is an India-based house-of-brands company that acquires, builds, and scales digital-first consumer brands across Health, Wellness, Lifestyle, Fashion, Party & Celebration, and Home Decor. Founded by Ananth Narayanan and backed by Accel, the company combines technology, data insight, and centralized operations to grow market-leading D2C brands from India for global customers. Its portfolio includes brands such as Majestic Pure, Botanic Hearth, Dennis Lingo, House of Ishin, and MyFitness. This is a company/provider profile in the API Evangelist network; BRND.ME operates a corporate marketing presence and does not publish a public developer API.

providers.name: FitStar
providers.description: FitStar Labs, Inc. was a San Francisco based consumer fitness company that built FitStar Personal Trainer and FitStar Yoga, adaptive video workout apps that adjusted each session to the user's feedback and fitness level. Backed by GV (Google Ventures) and Trinity Ventures, FitStar was acquired by Fitbit on March 5, 2015 for $17.8 million and folded into the Fitbit Coach product line. The company is DEFUNCT: the fitstar.com domain no longer serves web content (last archived live October 2017), the FitStar apps have been retired, and no developer portal, documentation, or public API surface survives. This profile is retained as a historical record in the API Evangelist network; there is nothing to enrich beyond identity and domain posture.

providers.name: Misfit
providers.description: Misfit is a consumer wearables brand — fitness trackers and smartwatches such as the Misfit Shine, Flash, Ray and Vapor — founded in 2011 by Sonny Vu, John Sculley and Sridhar Iyengar and backed by Norwest Venture Partners, Khosla Ventures, Founders Fund, GGV Capital and Xiaomi before being acquired by Fossil Group in 2015. Misfit ran a developer program (the Misfit Cloud API, Device SDK and Scientific Library) at build.misfit.com with 30+ launch partners. Fossil discontinued the Misfit backend, Cloud API and companion app in spring 2023, so the hosted API and all misfit.com domains are now unreachable. The only surviving developer surface is the official Misfit-Developers GitHub organization and its unmaintained iOS SDKs on CocoaPods.

providers.name: Big Health
providers.description: Big Health is a digital mental health company that develops evidence-based digital therapeutics for common mental health conditions. Its products include SleepioRx and DaylightRx, FDA-cleared prescription digital therapeutics for insomnia and generalized anxiety disorder, alongside the consumer apps Sleepio, Daylight, and Spark Direct. Big Health sells to health systems and providers, health plans, and employers rather than through a public developer program; it currently exposes no public API, developer portal, or SDK. Backed by Index Ventures and SoftBank Vision Fund.

providers.name: Curejoy
providers.description: CureJoy is a consumer health and wellness media company that publishes expert-reviewed content on alternative health, natural remedies, fitness, nutrition, and beauty. Backed by Accel, it grew into one of the larger natural-health content platforms, distributing articles and advice through its website and social channels. The public property is a WordPress.com-hosted content site with no first-party developer or product API; the only programmatic surface is the standard WordPress REST API (wp-json) exposed by the hosting platform, which is generic infrastructure rather than a published product offering.

providers.name: Life Time Group Holdings
providers.description: Life Time Group Holdings is an American health and wellness company operating large-format athletic resort destinations across the United States and Canada. The company offers fitness facilities, personal training, group classes, aquatics, indoor and outdoor sports, spa services, and healthy living programs in premium resort-style facilities, plus the Life Time app for members. Life Time does not currently publish a public developer API or developer portal.

providers.name: Crossfit
providers.description: CrossFit is a fitness brand and training methodology built around constantly varied, high-intensity functional movements that combine strength, conditioning, gymnastics, and weightlifting. The organization operates a global network of independently owned affiliate gyms, delivers a coaching certification and education program (the Level 1 through Level 4 courses and specialty seminars), and produces the annual CrossFit Games competition season. CrossFit was surfaced as a portfolio company of General Catalyst and added to the API Evangelist network as a lead; as of this enrichment pass the company publishes a consumer and affiliate web presence (gym finder, courses, store, Games results) but no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API definition.

providers.name: Peloton Interactive
providers.description: Peloton Interactive is a connected fitness company that produces interactive exercise equipment and a streaming subscription service. The company sells connected stationary bikes, treadmills, rowers, and a digital app offering live and on-demand fitness classes. Peloton has built a large community of members who participate in instructor-led workouts and track performance metrics through its platform.

providers.name: Bellabeat
providers.description: Bellabeat is a femtech and women's wellness technology company founded in 2014 by Urska Srsen and Sandro Mur, headquartered in San Francisco, California. It designs health-tracking wearables and connected devices aimed at women, including the Leaf and Ivy wellness jewelry trackers, the Time hybrid smartwatch, and the Spring smart water bottle, paired with the Bellabeat mobile app that tracks activity, sleep, stress, meditation, menstrual cycle, and overall wellness. Bellabeat operates as a direct-to-consumer wellness brand; it does not currently publish a public developer API, so this profile captures company identity and network provenance rather than API artifacts. Added to the API Evangelist network as a Y Combinator portfolio lead and enriched here.

providers.name: besunyen
providers.description: Besunyen is a Chinese consumer-health company known for herbal weight-management, functional and detox teas plus related wellness and nutrition products, surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub. Enrichment on 2026-07-18 found no public developer, API, or documentation surface — besunyen.com serves only an nginx 404 and its TLS certificate is issued for besunyen.co (hostname mismatch); the only real artifact captured is a domain-security probe.

providers.name: Breathe Well-being
providers.description: Breathe Well-being is an India-based digital therapeutics and chronic-care company focused on Type 2 diabetes reversal and management. Through a mobile app (Android/iOS) it pairs continuous health coaching, personalized nutrition and lifestyle plans, medical supervision, and progress tracking to help members reduce blood sugar, lose weight, and lower medication dependence. Founded by Aditya Kaicker and Rohan Verma, the company is backed by Accel and Y Combinator (Series A, 2021). It operates as a direct-to-consumer health program rather than an API provider: as of this enrichment pass it publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or /.well-known discovery surface (paths return the SPA lander fallback). This profile captures the company identity and its probed domain-security posture.

providers.name: Carevision Inc.
providers.description: Carevision Inc. is an AI-powered digital health company whose platform turns any camera into a 60-second contactless cardiometabolic wellness scanner. Using remote photoplethysmography (rPPG) and deep learning models trained on 12M+ patient records, it extracts 30+ physiological parameters — including heart rate, blood pressure indicators, stress index, respiratory rate, and oxygen saturation — and produces a comprehensive digital health persona covering 15+ cardiometabolic conditions. Carevision operates under the FDA General Wellness Policy (it is not a medical device or diagnostic tool) and is delivered as a kiosk, an embedded/white-label SDK for iOS and Android, or a web integration to hospitals and clinics, health insurers, pharmacy chains, diagnostic laboratories, wellness apps, and teleconsultation platforms, integrating with EMR/HIS systems.

providers.name: Fitocracy
providers.description: Fitocracy is a fitness gamification platform and social network that turns exercise into an RPG-style game, awarding points and levels for logged workouts and letting members join groups, take on challenges, and cheer each other on. Founded in 2011 and later acquired, it popularized applying game mechanics to habit-building and health tracking. Surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network; the public site currently returns HTTP 503 and exposes no documented API surface.

providers.name: Ginger
providers.description: Ginger (formerly Ginger.io) was a behavioral and emotional health company offering on-demand mental health support — coaching, therapy, and psychiatry — delivered through a mobile app and an employer/health-plan benefits model. Surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a Techstars portfolio lead, Ginger merged with Headspace in 2021 to form Headspace Health; the ginger.com domain now redirects to Headspace for Organizations (organizations.headspace.com). Enrichment probing on 2026-07-19 found no independent public API, developer portal, OpenAPI, SDKs, or /.well-known discovery surface — every /.well-known path resolves to a soft-404 Headspace marketing page. This profile is retained as an acquired-company record; the only genuine machine-derivable artifact is the live domain-security posture of ginger.com.

providers.name: Hero Journey Club
providers.description: Hero Journey Club is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of northzone and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: healthcare. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Instabeat
providers.description: Instabeat is a San Francisco based swimming technology company that builds a heart-rate monitoring device integrated directly into swim goggles, giving swimmers real-time, color-coded effort feedback (heart-rate zones), automatic stroke detection, lap counting, pace, distance and rest-interval tracking without a chest strap or wrist watch. Paired with the Instabeat mobile app and myinstabeat.com, it delivers data-driven training insights so swimmers can adjust workouts in the water rather than after the session. The company sells the device through a Shopify storefront and has tested the product with 250+ swimmers across 56 countries. Added to the API Evangelist network as a 500 Global portfolio company; no public developer or API surface has been identified.

providers.name: Magna
providers.description: Magna is a direct-to-consumer beverage brand (drinkmagna.com) making a magnesium-based electrolyte hydration drink mix. The product pairs a triple-magnesium formulation (malate, gluconate, glycinate) with electrolytes and is marketed to athletes and fitness enthusiasts for hydration, energy, and recovery. Backed by Forerunner Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network as a consumer-sector company profile. The brand operates as a retail/e-commerce storefront and publishes no public developer API, documentation, or developer portal at this time.

providers.name: MyLife
providers.description: MyLife (formerly Stop, Breathe & Think) was a meditation and mindfulness mobile app backed by 500 Global that guided users through short check-ins and recommended meditations based on how they were feeling. As of this enrichment pass the company's primary web presence at stopbreathethink.com no longer resolves to a live site (DNS and CAA records remain but there is no reachable HTTPS host), and no public developer, API, documentation, or SDK surface could be located. The company appears defunct.

providers.name: Planet Fitness
providers.description: The largest fitness franchise in the United States by number of members and locations, operating over 2,500 clubs in the US, Canada, Panama, Mexico, and Australia. Planet Fitness is known for its affordable membership model (Classic and Black Card tiers), the non-intimidating Judgement Free Zone philosophy targeting casual and first-time gym-goers, and the PF App for workout content, club check-in, and member benefits. Planet Fitness does not publish a public developer API, integration portal, or third-party platform program; integrations with workout content providers and biometric/check-in vendors are handled via private commercial partnerships, not public APIs.

providers.name: Prana Health
providers.description: Prana (prana.health) is a research-driven body-enhancement company building a system to engineer more muscle and less fat through three integrated steps: performance testing to measure a user's biology, predictive body-composition models that adapt training and nutrition protocols in real time, and personalized enhancement medicine to accelerate results safely. The platform centers on proprietary body-modeling technology, including its MUSCLE-1 hypertrophy prediction model, and is currently offered to users through a beta program. As of this profile Prana publishes a consumer marketing and research site only and exposes no public developer API, documentation, or SDKs.

providers.name: Shape Shapescale
providers.description: Shapescale is a consumer body-scanning company that builds ShapeScale, a home 3D body scanner and companion mobile app. The device slowly rotates around a standing user, captures a photorealistic 3D model of the body, and measures body composition, weight, and circumference metrics so users can track fitness and body changes over time. Shapescale is a Y Combinator portfolio company. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes a consumer product website but no public developer program, API reference, or machine-readable API artifacts.

providers.name: Silk and Sonder
providers.description: Silk and Sonder is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of 500-global, redpoint-ventures and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Sprout Wellness Solutions
providers.description: Sprout Wellness Solutions is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of techstars and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Switch
providers.description: Switch (operating as Livekick at livekick.com) is a 500 Global-backed company running a virtual fitness and yoga SaaS platform. The Livekick Serve product lets movement teachers and wellness creators deliver live and on-demand classes, videos, courses, and programs to students and communities, with subscription billing and creator tooling to grow an online audience. The public surface is a consumer/creator web and mobile application backed by an internal Django REST API; as of this enrichment pass Livekick publishes no public developer program — no developer portal, documentation, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, MCP server, or security.txt (all /.well-known and /llms.txt paths return the single-page-app shell). This profile is therefore identity-only, enriched with a probed domain-security posture rather than API artifacts.

providers.name: YOU-app
providers.description: YOU-app was a mobile wellbeing application built by Fifth Corner (Helsinki, Finland) that delivered daily "micro-actions" across food, mindfulness, movement, and mental wellbeing, blending social-media style photo sharing with habit-building and originally aligned to the UN Sustainable Development Goals. The company was acquired and is no longer operated as an independent product; the you-app.com domain now 302-redirects to Hintsa Performance (hintsa.com). No public API, developer portal, documentation, SDKs, or machine-readable specification was found during enrichment — this remains a consumer-app profile with no developer surface to catalog.

providers.name: Vail Resorts
providers.description: Profile for Vail Resorts in the API Evangelist network. Fortune F1000 (rank 929).

providers.name: Atlas Wearables
providers.description: Atlas Wearables was an Austin, Texas fitness-technology startup founded in 2013 by Peter Li, Mike Kasparian, and Alex Hsieh. It raised over $500,000 on Indiegogo in 2014 for the Atlas Wristband, a motion-tracking gym wearable whose "Exercise ID" technology automatically recognized strength exercises and counted reps and sets. The company shipped the Atlas Wristband and Wristband 2 and historically promoted an open developer API and integrations with apps such as MapMyFitness and Fitocracy. Atlas Wearables was acquired by Peloton Interactive in late 2020; the company no longer operates independently and the atlaswearables.com domain no longer resolves (it is now held by Peloton Interactive). This API Evangelist profile is retained as a historical record of a former Techstars-associated portfolio lead; no live developer surface, API specification, or documentation remains available to enrich.

providers.name: Getsupp
providers.description: Getsupp was an India-based digital health and wellness platform offering supplement and nutrition product discovery, personalized health recommendations, and online consultations with certified experts (nutritionists, dietitians, and coaches). The company was a General Catalyst portfolio company and was subsequently absorbed into Eka.care. As of this enrichment pass the getsupp.in and getsupp.com domains no longer serve a standalone site: both resolve to Eka.io infrastructure (65.0.57.69, TLS cert altnames *.eka.io) and return HTTP 404 for all paths. No public developer portal, API documentation, OpenAPI, /.well-known/ discovery, or /llms.txt could be found. This profile is retained as a portfolio lead with no enrichable API surface.

providers.name: Gixo
providers.description: Gixo was a consumer live-streaming fitness startup (coached, real-time running and workout classes delivered to a mobile app), surfaced as a portfolio company of Cowboy Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network as an enrichment lead. The enrichment pipeline probed the company on 2026-07-19 and found no live provider surface: gixo.com and www.gixo.com both HTTP 301-redirect to www.bodi.com (a Beachbody / BODi property), consistent with Gixo having been acquired and wound down into the Openfit / Beachbody / BODi fitness platform. No api.gixo.com or developer.gixo.com host resolves in DNS, and no /.well-known/ discovery surface, developer portal, documentation, SDKs, or public API is published. There is no API program to enrich; this profile is retained as a historical consumer-sector lead rather than an active provider.

providers.name: HelloFlo
providers.description: HelloFlo was a women's-health startup (a 500 Global / 500 Startups portfolio company) known for its subscription boxes and viral marketing. As of this enrichment pass its helloflo.com domain returns a permanent 301 redirect to theflowspace.com (Flow Space), a women's-health digital media platform owned by Penske Media Corporation. HelloFlo no longer operates as an independent company and publishes no public API, developer portal, documentation, SDKs, or any technical / developer surface. This profile is retained as a defunct/redirected network lead; there is nothing for the enrichment pipeline to harvest.

providers.name: Kerros Health
providers.description: Kerros Health (Kerros) was a digital mental-health and wellness startup building clinically validated, mobile-based programs proven to improve mental health, positioned as an evidence-based consumer brand modernizing established treatments through mobile technology and design. The product began as a teen-created mental-health app (originating out of Scarsdale High School) and grew largely through word of mouth. Co-founded by Justin Ip and backed by Cowboy Ventures at the seed stage, the company has since exited. It was a consumer mobile app with no public developer/API surface; this API Evangelist profile is maintained as a portfolio-lead record and no OpenAPI, SDK, or developer documentation could be found during enrichment.

providers.name: Millennial Fox
providers.description: Millennial Fox, Inc. is a Los Angeles-based consumer company backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners that set out to bridge the gap between entertainment and fitness. Its flagship product, Tracks Battle Squad, was a socially gamified workout companion for iOS and watchOS that integrated with the Apple Health app to turn physical activity into points, badges, and accessories for a virtual 3D fox character. The app launched in 2017, was featured on Apple Music's Planet of the Apps, and has since been removed from the App Store; the company appears inactive and exposes no public API, developer portal, documentation, or well-known surface.

providers.name: MycroFriends
providers.description: MycroFriends is a consumer health and wellness company that helps people become healthier through education and coaching centered on the connection between the human microbiome, nutrition, and overall health. Founded by George Cigale (previously founder of the online tutoring company Tutor.com) and headquartered in New York City, the company launched via a 2017 crowdfunding campaign and works with scientists, physicians, dietitians, and technologists to deliver microbiome education, personalized nutritional and lifestyle guidance, and access to expert health coaches. It was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Bloomberg Beta. As of this enrichment pass MycroFriends publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable API surface, and its former website resolves only to a default (unconfigured) Azure App Service host.

providers.name: Weilos
providers.description: Weilos was a health and wellness startup surfaced as an a16z portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. As of the 2026-07-21 enrichment pass the company no longer operates independently — weilos.com issues a 301 redirect to weightwatchers.com, indicating Weilos has been absorbed into WeightWatchers (WW). No independent developer surface exists — the hosts api.weilos.com, developer.weilos.com, and docs.weilos.com do not resolve in DNS, and there is no public API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, or developer portal to catalog. This profile is retained as an acquired/defunct lead with no API artifacts.

providers.name: Dream Voyage Inc.
providers.description: Dream Voyage Inc. is an AI-driven consumer studio founded in 2023 and backed by Andreessen Horowitz through its Speedrun accelerator alongside Soma Capital. Led by co-founder and CEO Coco Chen, a former TikTok founding product manager and Tinder PM, the studio builds viral AI-powered consumer applications spanning spiritual wellness, dream interpretation, gaming, and social payments. Its products include SINE Daily Manifest (an AI spiritual-health app offering daily affirmations, astrology, birth-chart analysis, and tarot readings that went viral on TikTok), Dreamore (AI-powered dream interpretation), Vdrop (turning social media into a payment network), and RPS (a Solana-based social game). Dream Voyage ships consumer mobile apps rather than a public developer platform; as of this profile it publishes no developer portal, OpenAPI, SDKs, or documented API surface. This record is a network stub retained for discovery and future enrichment.

providers.name: Saude Bliss
providers.description: Saude Bliss (saudebliss.com) is a health and wellness company surfaced as a portfolio company of speedinvest and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Its public presence is a Cloudflare-protected WordPress marketing website; a July 2026 enrichment pass found no public API surface, no OpenAPI/Swagger, no .well-known endpoints, no security.txt and no llms.txt. The upstream portfolio record marks it is_api_provider=false, so this remains an identity-only company profile rather than an API provider.
